name: Altropane
summary: Altropane (O-587, IACFT, 2β-carbomethoxy-3β-(4-fluorophenyl)-N-((E)-3-iodo-prop-2-enyl)tropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor and long-acting stimulant drug.

pharmacology.text: Altropane (O-587, IACFT, 2β-carbomethoxy-3β-(4-fluorophenyl)-N-((E)-3-iodo-prop-2-enyl)tropane) is a phenyltropane derivative which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor and long-acting stimulant drug.

uses.text: It has mainly been used as the 125I radiolabelled form for mapping the distribution of dopamine transporters in the brain, and consequently this has led to its development as a potential diagnostic tool for early detection of Parkinson's disease. It is also being investigated for potential use in the diagnosis and treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

sideEffects.en: As a diagnostic tracer it is given in tiny tracer form rather than for its effects. Little is known about taking it recreationally. Potent dopamine reuptake inhibitors as a class can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, anxiety and sleeplessness.
sideEffects.zh: 作為診斷用示蹤劑，它是以極微量的示蹤形式給予，而非為了藥效。關於娛樂性使用所知甚少。強效多巴胺回收抑制劑作為一類，可能造成心跳急促、血壓升高、焦慮與失眠。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为诊断用示踪剂，它是以极微量的示踪形式给予，而非为了药效。关于娱乐性使用所知甚少。强效多巴胺回收抑制剂作为一类，可能造成心跳急促、血压升高、焦虑与失眠。

fact.en: It is built on the tropane skeleton, the same ring system found in cocaine and in atropine from deadly nightshade. Made with radioactive iodine, it lets doctors photograph dopamine nerve endings in the living brain.
fact.zh: 它建立在托烷骨架上，也就是古柯鹼與顛茄中阿托品共有的環系。以放射性碘標記後，它能讓醫師拍攝活體腦中多巴胺神經末梢的影像。
fact.zhHans: 它创建在托烷骨架上，也就是古柯碱与颠茄中阿托品共有的环系。以放射性碘标记后，它能让医师拍摄活体脑中多巴胺神经末梢的影像。
